sources.notes: Open Data DC is an ArcGIS Hub. The confirmed files are the Hub CSV exports: 'Integrated Tax System Public Extract' (ITSPE; the tax assessment roll: SSL, use code, owner, premise and billing addresses, land area, assessment), 'Computer Assisted Mass Appraisal - Commercial' (CAMA: year built, gross building area, units per SSL), and the 'Integrated Tax System Property Use Codes' table (the use-code definitions). Each export URL redirects to hub.arcgis.com. robots.txt on opendata.dc.gov sets Crawl-delay: 60 (the collector honours it: about a minute between requests) and disallows /sites/, /admin/, /sessions/, /groups/, /people/, /workspace/; maps2.dcgis.dc.gov has no robots.txt. The terms page is rendered by JavaScript, so the collector cannot read it as text; the license is read from the dataset metadata. The ITSPE feature service name carries its extract date (ITSPE_08172026) and the datasets are republished daily.
